content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Gumroad and Payhip offer basic e-commerce features such as product hosting, payment processing, and order management. However, their reliance on Stripe and PayPal limits their accessibility in restricted countries. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a comprehensive solution for digital creators. It includes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This infrastructure allows creators to build a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment verification, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip's reliance on Stripe and PayPal makes them unavailable in countries with restricted access. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to operate independently of these payment platforms. With a focus on infrastructure sovereignty, COREMERCH empowers digital creators to build and deploy their commerce stacks without relying on restricted payment platforms. This makes COREMERCH a more viable option for digital creators in countries with restricted access.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.

This enables instant product delivery and automatic crypto payment verification.
